name: Icon Composer
title: developer.apple.com/icon-composer
shortDescription: Icon Composer is a tool designed for creating multi-layered icons for Apple devices including iPhone, iPad, Mac, and Apple Watch. It utilizes a new material called Liquid Glass to enhance icon design with properties like translucency and shadows. The tool integrates seamlessly with Xcode, allowing developers to directly import icons into their projects. Ideal for designers looking to maintain consistency across devices with minimal effort.
pros: Multi-platform support for all Apple devices
Real-time preview with dynamic lighting effects
